sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:145618
Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 25008 of 2023

Applicant :- Ratan Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Krishna Kant Shukla

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
01.
Heard Shri Krishna Kant Shukla, learned counsel for applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

02. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant seeking bail in case crime no.215 of
2015, under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C., P.S. Thakurdwara, District Moradabad.

03. As per version of the F.I.R., first informant was duped of Rs.25 lac of his hard earned money by
six persons named in the F.I.R. who acted in an organized manner and took him under their
influence on a number of false pretext.

04.  It is contended on behalf of the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case; no specific role has been assigned to the applicant; in this case after investigation the police filed final report but on a protest petition filed by the first informant the applicant has been summoned.

My attention has been drawn to the facts mentioned in the F.I.R.
wherein the first informant has said that accused persons returned Rs.10 lac out of 25 lac taken from him and that only Rs.10 lac remain to be paid; it is argued that there is no evidence to suggest that it was him who had received any money;the applicant is in custody since 18.03.2023 i.e. since last more than three months.

Ratan Singh vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93474213/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The application for bail is opposed by learned A.G.A.

However, certain aspects of the matter could not be refuted by learned A.G.A.
06.
I considered nature of the allegations, role ascribed to the applicant, the evidence proposed, the severity of punishment and all other facts and circumstances of the case.
In my view, a case for bail is made out.

07. Let applicant - Ratan Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid Case Crime Number on his furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.

(iii) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) framing of charge and (ii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. without exception.
08.
Any violation of above conditions will be treated as misuse of bail and learned Court below will be at liberty to pass appropriate order.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023/Asha  Ratan Singh vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93474213/
